ASTRA ULTRA — FINAL RESEARCH-STATE HANDOFF
9 October 2026. This closes the current authorized run at the user's
requested checkpoint. No broad new cycle is authorized by this handoff.

DECISION AND PROOF STATUS

The foundational 10/10 objective has NOT been achieved. The strongest new
high-upside result is a complete internally reconstructed candidate for
unanchored parallel repetition of arbitrary finite commuting-operator games.
Its independent composition reviews are complete. Abstract stress-tuple
rectifiability also has two independently reconstructed proofs and completed
cross-audits. These are substantial mathematical candidates, not externally
established breakthroughs. No new theorem here has acquired expert external
validation, a proof-assistant certificate, or exhaustive priority clearance.

"Complete internal proof" means an actual argument has been preserved and
the stated internal audits found no unresolved proof gate at its exact
premises. It does not mean that model agreement certifies correctness.
"Conditional application" retains its named imported theorem interfaces.
Finite computation, hash replay, archive integrity and source-reported
formalization are distinct evidence categories. Do not promote one to another.

FRESH-INSTANCE READING ROUTE (NO CONVERSATION REQUIRED)

1. Read this file and COMMUTING_COMPOSITION.txt. These supersede historical
   pending statuses in the frozen packets; those packets are not rewritten.
2. Read CURRENT_CLAIMS.json and ARTIFACT_ROUTES.json. Each route identifies
   original paths and SHA-256 hashes, plus copied primary proof artifacts.
3. For square interfaces, read square/SQUARE_ENTRYPOINT.txt and
   square/ADAPTIVE_REVIEW_STATUS_AND_PRECISION.txt, then use the square JSON
   artifact/dependency index. This is the authoritative short restart route
   to the COMPLETE square programme, not just its Gaussian bulk theorem.
4. Read mixed-trace/FINAL_REVIEW_STATUS.txt for the last bounded analytic
   closure. No geometric application follows merely from that inequality.
5. Read PRESERVATION_AND_RESTART.txt. Use RESTORE.py to restore selected
   original paths from ASTRA_ULTRA_FINAL_RESEARCH_CHECKPOINT.zip into a NEW
   directory. The archive includes all current non-cache research artifacts,
   all tracked source bytes and all earlier checkpoint/output ZIPs.
